verses.text: Ex aj Sion, b'oekoch smuroal b'aj tze kol he b'a, yujto ix jawi hoyan heb' ajk'ol t'a he patik. Ol smak' spak'ultak sti' winh yajalil Israel heb' yet' te' jixk'ab' te'.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha chonhab' Belén ay t'a Efrata, wach'chom yunenhej t'a skal chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, palta hata' ol kot jun ol wak'och yajalil t'a yib'anh in chonhab' Israel. Ol kot t'a jun inhtilal aytaxon t'a peka', a jun ol ak'an yajalil chi', aytaxon yiktax yichb'anel, xchi Jehová.

Haxo tiknaik, ol yaktejkan schonhab' Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, masanto ol aljok jun yune' ix ix wan stanhwan yalji chi'. Ichato chi' ol meltzaj heb' sk'ab' yok jun Yajal ik'b'ilkanb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol smolb'anxi sb'a heb' yet' heb' yetchonhab'.

Ha jun Rey chi', ol k'e waan yet' spoder yet' yopisio ak'b'il yuj Jehová yik stanhwej schonhab', yik tz'aj heb' t'a junk'olal, yujto a jun Rey chi', niwan ol aj yelk'och t'a skal masanil nakión b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha jun Rey chi' ol ik'ankot junk'olal. Ayik ol jawok heb' aj Asiria t'a yol ko nakión tik, yik tz'och heb' t'a yoltak ko kuartel, ol ko chekb'at ukwanh wajxakwanhok heb' yajal niwak yelk'ochi, yik syak' owal heb' yet' heb' aj Asiria chi'.

Ha heb' chi' yet' k'een yespada heb' ol yak' ganar heb' aj Asiria chi', haton snakión winhaj Nimrod. Ol onh kolchaj yuj jun kajalil t'a heb' aj Asiria chi', ayik ol k'axpajek'ta heb' t'a ko mojon yik syik'anek' lum ko lu'um heb' yalani.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob ixto kani, yuj heb' ol ja wach'ilal t'a skal juntzanh nakión, icha tz'aj yak'an yaxilal yal ak'wal, ma yaxnhab' t'a yib'anh anh ank'ultak syak'kot Jehová, manhok heb' anima tz'ak'ankoti.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob olto kan chi', lajan ol aj heb' t'a skal juntzanh nakión icha junok nok' choj ay t'a skal nok' k'ultakil nok', ma icha junok nok' choj tz'och t'a skal junok nhilanh nok' kalnel. Ayik tz'och nok' t'a skal nok' kalnel chi', syamankot nok' skotak tzilchitanb'at nok'. Manhxa junok mach syal skolanel nok'.
Ex yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, icha chi' ol aj eyak'an ganar heb' eyajk'ool, ol he satanel heb'.
Ex wetisraelal, a Jehová tz'alan icha tik t'ayex: Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol in mak'cham nok' he chej, ol in satanel he karruaje yik owal.
Ha he chonhab' ayoch smuroal yet' he kuartel ol in satel t'a junelnhej.
Ol in satanel heb' ajb'aal t'a he kal. Manhxo junok heb' ajchum ol wak'kan t'a he kal chi'.
Ol in satel juntzanh he komon Dios yet' k'een k'een b'aj tzex lesalwi, yik manhxo ol ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh tas tze b'o he diosalok chi'.
Ol in tok'k'eta masanil te te' b'aj tzex och ejmelal, ol in satanel he chonhab' b'aj tzeyak' he silab' t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Yet' wal yowal in k'ool ol in paktzitej t'a juntzanh nakión max in k'anab'ajan jab'ok, xchi Jehová.
